[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/ffe733fcee28bac34172669e11efea002f0d4b57.png[/img]

notes.title: Cannibal Update: Stabilizing Sales and Curator Caution
notes.notes:
Hello Cannibal Lovers,

Today marks the seventh day since the release of our game, and by tomorrow, our first week will be complete.

A quick update on the numbers:
Conversions have declined compared to the first day, which was anticipated, but they are now stabilizing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/17e72983f2996c25425c28e955c61c1139bcd719.png[/img]

Wishlists continue to grow, though the increase rate has slowed since the peak on release day. We've gained an additional 1k wishlists in nearly a week. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/8b0a2d6be4628cb1937294acfd4beff7fc528c4d.png[/img]

Currently, 60% of sales have resulted from converting a wishlist into a purchase.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/8b3d7c6e3438007954e028cf2fc66697621591ac.png[/img]

Tomorrow, we will release the first update, which includes adding video settings to the options menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/c20490602a863fd2e884efd77b00e20ca6a7ec2f.png[/img]

Soon after, we'll introduce the localization system, adding Italian and Russian as the first languages.

Recently, we've been receiving numerous emails requesting promotional codes from Steam curators. Interestingly, many request these via email and advise against using Steam's internal key distribution system within the curator section, which we suspect could be scams. Therefore, we have not responded to these emails. We have only sent promotional codes using Steam’s internal system to curators who have requested to review the game through this official channel.

That’s all for today.
Have a great evening from your trusty neighborhood Cannibal Team.

notes.title: Celebrating Success and Addressing Feedback on Day Five
notes.notes:
Hello Cannibal Lovers,

Today marks the fifth day since the release of our game.

I’d like to take a moment to talk about the release. We’re thrilled to report that 90% of the reviews have been positive, and we truly appreciate the kind words and praise.

However, we have received two negative reviews, regrettably from fellow Italians. Both critiques focused on the absence of an Italian language option. 

I want to highlight to these individuals (and others) the critical impact reviews on Steam can have. They significantly influence sales and can make or break a project, potentially wasting months or even years of a team’s effort.

Criticizing a game for lacking Italian language support may seem trivial for several reasons. 

First, the available languages [b]are clearly listed on the game’s Steam page[/b], so buyers know what to expect. If someone wanted the game in Italian, they could have chosen not to purchase it and wait for the first update, which will include localization.

Additionally, we have frequently communicated through these devlogs that we are working on adding more languages. Implementing localization takes time, and unfortunately, the sales from Cannibal Tales alone aren’t enough to allow us to focus solely on this project.

Lastly, games are often released in English first because it’s one of the most widely spoken languages globally, [b]unlike Italian[/b]. Prioritizing English allows us to reach a broader audience without the immediate need for managing multiple localizations and incurring the associated translation costs, which are typically expensive.

So next time, before leaving a review, please take a deep breath and spend some time reflecting on what you would like to write.

That said, we’ll catch up with you tomorrow.

Have a great evening from your trusty neighborhood Cannibal Team.

[b]Day three post-release, let's review the first two days.[/b]

The numbers are in line with our forecasts. Unfortunately, we didn't have a large number of wishlists; by release, we had reached 2,500 wishlists. The conversion at launch was consistent with the "magic formulas" taught to us by [b]Chris Zukowski[/b]. 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/f323ee058b58e8ad7a2eca6723ac5c90ba4eac8d.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/905c3b91f25e609f42b5be07bc1e4000cfe4a39f.jpg[/img][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/ae2401456fd689f773b194f2ff72010dacf53c09.png[/img]

On the second day, we experienced a sales drop of about one-third, which was anticipated. Additionally, on the day of the release, our wishlists saw a spike, increasing by 20% in just one day.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/c5a705901b3bd27a37c3fdc6b5968f26f7ae9062.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/8297e4462ba0fcd29ecc81c5b43e77912fad6bea.png[/img]

On our Discord server, a user has offered to help localize the game into Russian, which will be one of the first languages we add, along with Italian.

We are seeking individuals capable of assisting with Japanese and Chinese localization. Please contact us on our Discord server if you know someone.

Regarding console porting, Nintendo Switch and PlayStation are currently confirmed. Unfortunately, Microsoft has not yet approved the game, rejecting the concept.

That’s all for today.
See you tomorrow!

notes.title: The day after
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

First and foremost, we extend our heartfelt thanks to all who supported us by purchasing the game on Day 1. Your enthusiasm is what keeps us going—THANK YOU!

Today, I'd like to address a recent negative review that highlighted two main issues:
[list]
[*] Lack of localization in languages other than English
[*] The perceived brevity of the gameplay experience.
[/list]
We genuinely appreciate this feedback, and it’s something we are actively working on. We often encourage our players to discuss their concerns directly with us on our Discord server, as it gives us an opportunity to explain our choices and constraints more transparently.

Localizing a game is a substantial endeavor, especially for a small studio like ours. Many might not realize the current challenges in maintaining a game development company. Aside from our own projects, we have to undertake B2B work to sustain our operations. Rest assured, we are committed to implementing a robust localization system, and Italian, along with other languages like German, French, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, and soon Japanese and Chinese, are on the way. The timing and quality of these localizations are tied to the financial outcomes of this first episode.

Regarding the length of the game, we believe that the essence of a story is not dictated by its duration but by the impact it delivers. Whether in a book, a movie, or a game, the potency of the narrative is what truly matters. Thus, it's misleading to equate shortness with a lack of depth or value.

Thank you for your ongoing support and understanding. Your engagement is crucial for our continued development and success. We're excited about the journey ahead and promise to keep you updated.

For now, that's all.
Greetings from your trusted Cannibal Team.

notes.title: New Release Date for Cannibal Tales
notes.notes:
Hello Cannibal Lovers,

It's been a while since we've shared an update on our project.

As some of you might have noticed, we did not participate in the February Steam Next Fest. Despite being regularly registered, due to Steam's incorrect judgment on the sexual content within our game, we no longer met the requirements to participate in the Next Fest and were excluded.

We spent considerable time explaining to the Steam team that our game does not feature frequent sexual content and nudity, and we finally managed to have this tag removed by Steam. Now, the game can be found in searches even without disabling the filters for adult content. Let's celebrate!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/a41b52456fc6a526dfaaee51402a859e7347d1b5.jpg[/img]

Originally, we planned to release the game on Steam in early March, using the Next Fest as a showcase. However, since we did not participate, we decided to wait until the console versions were ready to launch on multiple platforms. We are currently working on the porting and aim to release the PC and console versions in early May. Funnily enough, May 7th is Ruggero Deodato's birthday, and we couldn't resist the opportunity to align our release with his special day.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/718cc555811f86c7f9aae27df78395a9696fb300.jpg[/img]

On the localization front, we'll start with an English-only release. But don't worry; we're planning to add Spanish, French, German, Italian, and Brazilian Portuguese versions shortly after.

We're also putting the finishing touches on our release trailer. Keep your eyes peeled for more details coming your way soon. 

That's all for now!

notes.title: Overcoming Steam's 'Adult Content' Tag: A Dev Journey Update
notes.notes:
Hello cannibal lover,
Welcome to our first devlog of 2024. 
We wish to start by wishing you all a happy new year and hope that you have had a peaceful and joyous holiday season.

Let's begin by telling you that we are facing an issue with Steam. 
Currently, our game is tagged as 'Frequent Nudity or Sexual Content'. This is due to a misassessment on our part of some of the game's content during the setup of the product page on Steam. 
We are working to remove the adult-only classification. This tag prevents the game from appearing in the searches of users who have disabled the viewing of adult content games, causing us significant issues in terms of discoverability and wishlist additions.

We have attempted to censor the nudity scenes (Helena's breasts) in the public demo, but this was not sufficient for the Steam review team. 
They argue that a significant portion of our game contains sexual content, especially since the first chapter takes place entirely in Helena's bedroom, where she and Paul are engaged in a sexual act at the beginning of the game. 
However, our game does not feature any other sexually explicit content, and the storyline is mainly focused on the theme of cannibalism. Despite our efforts, we have not been able to change Steam's stance.

Furthermore, Steam has notified us that two out of eight screenshots from our game display sexual content. However, we are convinced that these images have been misunderstood.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/fdac6577a4044c81cd02eb07fda91d37246ee02b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/e9fe7d65734207cb891ce71801de619c771e29da.jpg[/img]

Our next steps include removing the screenshots in question and replacing them with others that better represent the theme and atmosphere of the game. Following this, we will submit the full build of the game to Steam for review, to demonstrate that the main focus of the title is on different aspects from sexual content, mainly related to the theme of cannibalism. 
We sincerely hope that this action will persuade the Steam review team to remove the 'Frequent Nudity or Sexual Content' tag from our game.

Regarding the game's development progress, as previously mentioned, all chapters have been completed. We are currently localizing the last four chapters into English. Afterward, we will focus on finalizing the savings systems, options, and credits. Our goal is to finalize these elements by the end of January. 

We will participate in the Steam Next Fest in February with an updated version of the demo. 
The official release of the game is scheduled for the end of February.

That's all for now. We'll talk again next week.

The Cannibal Team.

By signing up for our mailing list here ---> https://subscribepage.io/KizWnG

notes.title: Key Characters Unveiled: Dive into Details and Concept Art Beyond the Demo!
notes.notes:
Hello cannibal lovers,
In this devlog, we'll shed some light on protagonists you've yet to meet in the demo, while ensuring we keep the story's twists under wraps.

[b]Noah[/b]
At 30 years old, Noah carries the demeanor and innocence of a child. Shaped by traumatic family events, he's learned to minimize his presence, almost fading into the background. His thin stature symbolizes his vulnerability. Despite rarely showing an appetite, he has a soft spot for chocolate, a rare indulgence bringing him a fleeting sense of pleasure. His dynamic with the cannibal Price is an enigma that the game will unravel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/439d75064be117f137e9aa1920cf83ec8cf08b58.jpg[/img]

[b]Price[/b]
A cannibal and a serial killer, Price has a horrifying tendency to feast on his victims while they're still alive. Although the police have been on his trail for years, he remains elusive. Masterfully, he lures his victims online, weaving relationships built on trust and dependency.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/9d6073fe47f4ec0ebd5fcadafb110f6660b1a471.jpg[/img]

[b]Maura[/b]
The nurse in the psychiatric institution where NOAH is confined. Driven purely by monetary gain, Maura is not one to be trusted.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/10ad28d0345c7445eba7bee6ec6419535d81eb44.jpg[/img]

We warmly invite you to join our mailing list to secure your spot in our upcoming closed beta scheduled for October: [url=https://subscribepage.io/KizWnG]https://subscribepage.io/KizWnG[/url]
Stay tuned for more details that we'll share soon.

That's all for now.
Cannibal Team

notes.title: Unmasking the Shadows: Meet the Haunting Characters of Cannibal Tales!
notes.notes:
Hello cannibal lovers, 
Today, we're delving deeper into the characters that breathe life into our narrative. For this first look, we're spotlighting the individuals you've met within our demo: 


[b]Helena[/b]
A thirty-year-old American journalist, Helena works for a shock site named "Bloody Disgusting", think of something akin to 'Rotten'. Helena is trapped in a tumultuous relationship with her boss, Paul, who also owns the site. Their bond is rife with violence, with Helena being submissively ensnared in Paul's sinister web. Beyond their personal connection, Helena yearns for more - a stake in "Bloody Disgusting". She's hinted at this ambition to Paul, who, in his twisted manner, has agreed, but on one condition: an exclusive interview with Noah, an asylum inmate who miraculously survived a harrowing ordeal with the cannibalistic serial killer, Delgado. Paul is thirsty for the chilling details of Noah's survival tale. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/ad6e5490815d4dbcd6c66ab24422262673254465.jpg[/img]

[b]Paul[/b]
A European-born entrepreneur and the mastermind behind "Bloody Disgusting", Paul revels in the site's macabre content. The means through which he acquires the gory content remains shadowed in mystery, often skirting the edges of legality. His demeanor is sadistic, and he revels in exercising dominion over others, particularly Helena, manipulating her with threats and cruelty to get what he desires. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/9634de44283cce4b9eadbc84a6ac0c335884fd57.jpg[/img]

A quick side note: Using the name [b]"Bloody Disgusting"[/b] for the site is a homage by Ruggero Deodato to one of the most renowned and influential horror news websites globally. This reference was entrenched in Ruggero's original script. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217438/45d47895a0356bd73428246afdc0a351ef649ccf.jpg[/img]

Wrapping up with some quick reminders: 
Come October, we're launching a closed beta! This will be your chance to preview fresh game content and experience an updated version shaped by your invaluable feedback. To partake, simply sign up for our mailing list here: [url=https://subscribepage.io/KizWnG]https://subscribepage.io/KizWnG[/url]. 


That's all for now. Stay tuned for more updates soon! 
Cannibal Team

notes.title: Continuing the Legacy: Introducing Cannibal Tales
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We have an important announcement regarding our collaboration with Ruggero Deodato. Despite his unexpected passing 5 months ago, we have decided to continue the project in a new form: [b]Cannibal Tales[/b].

As you may know, Ruggero was the main investor in our ongoing project, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1286420/Borneo_A_Jungle_Nightmare/]Borneo: a Jungle Nightmare[/url]. Unfortunately, due to a lack of funds, the development has been halted. We have attempted to secure funding by pitching the project to publishers and private investors, but so far we have been unsuccessful. We do not have the necessary resources to complete the required vertical slice.

Therefore, we have made the decision to change direction and return to the original idea of our collaboration with Ruggero Deodato. We will create a visual novel using the master's unpublished screenplay, and the project will be called [b]Cannibal Tales[/b]. The story will be divided into three parts, with different protagonists whose stories are intricately intertwined, and the theme of cannibalism will always be present in various forms and aspects.

Cannibal Tales will be a game consisting of three episodes:

	1- The Interview
	2- The Embalmer
	3- Borneo: A Jungle Nightmare

The project has sustainable development costs for our studio, and we plan to release the first episode by Winter 2023.

Our hope is that the sales of the first two episodes will enable us to find the necessary funds to complete the third and final episode, "Borneo: a Jungle Nightmare," while maintaining the same artistic direction and gameplay that we were pursuing with Ruggero Deodato.

In the coming months, we will provide more information about the project.

Thank you for your support.
